market.basis: heading names the planning region (a county equivalent); legacy-county composition is an approximation

ct.basis_legacy: approximation from legacy counties; a town-level crosswalk is needed for exactness
ct.fit_legacy: approximate: Southeastern Connecticut covers most of New London County; a few shoreline towns sit in the Lower Connecticut River Valley region
ct.fit_planning: exact: heading names Southeastern CT, the Southeastern Connecticut Planning Region

market.reason: Planning region is exact; New London County is a close but not exact legacy match.
